en: A black-and-white, wintertime photograph of a large institutional complex set in a snowy landscape. The buildings are arranged in a formal layout with multiple wings and auxiliary structures, and the scene is surrounded by fields, forests, and hills. The image has a caption in German at the top, printed in red, referencing 'Heilstätte der Landesversicherungsanstalt Kgr. Sachsen' and 'Bad Gottleuba – Im Winter.'
